_purpose: Truth anchor for size/hash checks on append-only essence files and static files, plus completeness baselines for data structures. Updated by closing-move-atomic when files change deliberately. Round 74 doctrine §11.

products_db_completeness_baseline._purpose: Tier counts from tools/products_db_audit.py at known-good moment. The check_products_db_completeness_no_regression invariant compares current counts to these baseline values. Update at closing-move-atomic when completeness deliberately improves (e.g., post-OCR pass, post-rescrape pass).
products_db_completeness_baseline.round_label: Pass A.2.5 — initial baseline post Pass A.2 audit

notes: When an append-only file grows deliberately, update its append_only_baselines entry in the same patch as the file change. When products-db completeness deliberately improves (more fully-populated, fewer skeletal), update products_db_completeness_baseline in the same patch as the data-completion work. Otherwise the next audit will pass trivially and lose the truth-anchor protection.
